sanskrit: grahaṃ tu suṣuve yaṃ taṃ siṃhī candrārkamardanam krātha ity abhivikhyātaḥ so 'bhavan manujādhipaḥ
english: The demon Siṃhī gave birth to that Graha who oppresses the moon and sun; he became known among men as King Krātha.

sanskrit: anāyuṣas tu putrāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ pravaro 'suraḥ vikṣaro nāma tejasvī vasumitro 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
english: The foremost among the four sons of Anāyus was the powerful demon Vikṣara; that radiant one became King Vasumitra among men.

sanskrit: dvitīyo vikṣarādyas tu narādhipa mahāsuraḥ pāṃsurāṣṭrādhipa iti viśrutaḥ so 'bhavan nṛpaḥ
english: The second after Vikṣara, O lord of men, was a great demon who became king renowned as the lord of Pāṃsurāṣṭra.

sanskrit: balavīra iti khyāto yas tv āsīd asurottamaḥ pauṇḍramatsyaka ity eva sa babhūva narādhipaḥ
english: He who was known as Balavīra, that foremost of demons, became the king called the lord of Pauṇḍramatsyaka among men.

sanskrit: vṛtra ity abhivikhyāto yas tu rājan mahāsuraḥ maṇimān nāma rājarṣiḥ sa babhūva narādhipaḥ
english: He who was widely renowned as Vṛtra, that great demon, O king, became the royal sage known as Maṇimān, a lord of men.

sanskrit: krodhahanteti yas tasya babhūvāvarajo 'suraḥ daṇḍa ity abhivikhyātaḥ sa āsīn nṛpatiḥ kṣitau
english: The demon who was Vṛtra's younger brother, known as Krodhahantā, became the king on earth widely renowned as Daṇḍa.

sanskrit: krodhavardhana ity eva yas tv anyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ daṇḍadhāra iti khyātaḥ so 'bhavan manujeśvaraḥ
english: He who was known as Krodhavardhana became the lord of men known as Daṇḍadhāra.

sanskrit: kālakāyās tu ye putrās teṣām aṣṭau narādhipāḥ jajñire rājaśārdūla śārdūlasamavikramāḥ
english: The sons of Kālakā — eight of them were born as lords of men, O tiger among kings, with valor equal to a tiger.

sanskrit: magadheṣu jayatsenaḥ śrīmān āsīt sa pārthivaḥ aṣṭānāṃ pravaras teṣāṃ kāleyānāṃ mahāsuraḥ
english: Among the Māgadhas, the illustrious Jayatsena was king; he was the foremost of those eight sons of Kālakā, that great demon.

sanskrit: dvitīyas tu tatas teṣāṃ śrīmān harihayopamaḥ aparājita ity eva sa babhūva narādhipaḥ
english: The second among them, illustrious as Indra's steed, became the lord of men known as Aparājita, the unconquered.

sanskrit: tṛtīyas tu mahārāja mahābāhur mahāsuraḥ niṣādādhipatir jajñe bhuvi bhīmaparākramaḥ
english: The third, O great king, was a great demon of mighty arms who was born on earth as the lord of the Niṣādas, of fearsome valor.

sanskrit: teṣām anyatamo yas tu caturthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ śreṇimān iti vikhyātaḥ kṣitau rājarṣisattamaḥ
english: He who is listed as the fourth among them became known on earth as Śreṇimān, the foremost of royal sages.

sanskrit: pañcamas tu babhūvaiṣāṃ pravaro yo mahāsuraḥ mahaujā iti vikhyāto babhūveha paraṃtapaḥ
english: The fifth, who was the foremost great demon among them, became known here as Mahaujā, the scourge of foes.

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭhas tu matimān yo vai teṣām āsīn mahāsuraḥ abhīrur iti vikhyātaḥ kṣitau rājarṣisattamaḥ
english: The sixth, who was the wise great demon among them, became known on earth as Abhīru, the foremost of royal sages.

sanskrit: samudrasenaś ca nṛpas teṣām evābhavad gaṇāt viśrutaḥ sāgarāntāyāṃ kṣitau dharmārthatattvavit
english: From that same group, the king Samudrasena was born, renowned across the sea-girdled earth, versed in the truth of righteousness and worldly gain.

sanskrit: bṛhan nāmāṣṭamas teṣāṃ kāleyānāṃ paraṃtapaḥ babhūva rājan dharmātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
english: Named Bṛhan, the eighth of those sons of Kālakā, O king, was a scorcher of foes, righteous in soul and devoted to the welfare of all beings.

sanskrit: gaṇaḥ krodhavaśo nāma yas te rājan prakīrtitaḥ tataḥ saṃjajñire vīrāḥ kṣitāv iha narādhipāḥ
english: The demonic host known as the Krodhavaśas, which I have enumerated for you, O king — from them were born heroes here on earth as lords of men.

sanskrit: nandikaḥ karṇaveṣṭaś ca siddhārthaḥ kīṭakas tathā suvīraś ca subāhuś ca mahāvīro 'tha bāhlikaḥ
english: Nandika, Karṇaveṣṭa, Siddhārtha, Kīṭaka, Suvīra, Subāhu, Mahāvīra, and Bāhlika —

sanskrit: krodho vicityaḥ surasaḥ śrīmān nīlaś ca bhūmipaḥ vīradhāmā ca kauravya bhūmipālaś ca nāmataḥ
english: Krodha, Vicitya, Surasā, the illustrious Nīla the earth-lord, Vīradhāman, and the one named Bhūmipāla, O descendant of Kuru —

sanskrit: dantavaktraś ca nāmāsīd durjayaś caiva nāmataḥ rukmī ca nṛpaśārdūlo rājā ca janamejayaḥ
english: Dantavaktra by name, Durjaya by name, Rukmī the tiger among kings, and King Janamejaya —

sanskrit: āṣāḍho vāyuvegaś ca bhūritejās tathaiva ca ekalavyaḥ sumitraś ca vāṭadhāno 'tha gomukhaḥ
english: Āṣāḍha, Vāyuvega, Bhūritejas, Ekalavya, Sumitrā, Vāṭadhāna, and Gomukha —

sanskrit: kārūṣakāś ca rājānaḥ kṣemadhūrtis tathaiva ca śrutāyur uddhavaś caiva bṛhatsenas tathaiva ca
english: The Kārūṣaka kings, Kṣemadhūrti, Śrutāyus, Uddhava, and Bṛhatsena as well —

sanskrit: kṣemogratīrthaḥ kuharaḥ kaliṅgeṣu narādhipaḥ matimāṃś ca manuṣyendra īśvaraś ceti viśrutaḥ
english: Kṣemogratīrtha, Kuhara the lord of men among the Kaliṅgas, Matimān, and the one renowned as Īśvara, O lord of men —

sanskrit: gaṇāt krodhavaśād evaṃ rājapūgo 'bhavat kṣitau jātaḥ purā mahārāja mahākīrtir mahābalaḥ
english: From the Krodhavaśa host there thus arose on earth a multitude of kings, born in ancient times, O great king, of great fame and great strength.

sanskrit: yas tv āsīd devako nāma devarājasamadyutiḥ sa gandharvapatir mukhyaḥ kṣitau jajñe narādhipaḥ
english: He who was the chief lord of the Gandharvas, named Devaka, equal in splendor to the king of the gods, was born on earth as a lord of men.

sanskrit: bṛhaspater bṛhatkīrter devarṣer viddhi bhārata aṃśād droṇaṃ samutpannaṃ bhāradvājam ayonijam
english: Know, O descendant of Bharata, that Droṇa son of Bharadvāja, not born of a womb, arose from a portion of the divine sage Bṛhaspati of great renown.

sanskrit: dhanvināṃ nṛpaśārdūla yaḥ sa sarvāstravittamaḥ bṛhatkīrtir mahātejāḥ saṃjajñe manujeṣv iha
english: He who was that Bṛhatkīrti of great radiance, the foremost knower of all weapons among archers, was born here among men, O tiger among kings.

sanskrit: dhanurvede ca vede ca yaṃ taṃ vedavido viduḥ variṣṭham indrakarmāṇaṃ droṇaṃ svakulavardhanam
english: Him whom those versed in the Vedas know as the supreme one in the science of archery and in the Veda, who performs deeds like Indra — that Droṇa, the enhancer of his lineage.

sanskrit: mahādevāntakābhyāṃ ca kāmāt krodhāc ca bhārata ekatvam upapannānāṃ jajñe śūraḥ paraṃtapaḥ
english: From the combined essence of Mahādeva and Antaka, from both desire and wrath, O descendant of Bharata, was born that hero, the scourge of foes.

sanskrit: aśvatthāmā mahāvīryaḥ śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ vīraḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ kṣitāv āsīn narādhipa
english: Aśvatthāman of great valor, destroyer of the enemy host, that hero with eyes like lotus petals, was a lord of men upon the earth, O king.

sanskrit: jajñire vasavas tv aṣṭau gaṅgāyāṃ śaṃtanoḥ sutāḥ vasiṣṭhasya ca śāpena niyogād vāsavasya ca
english: The eight Vasus were born as sons of Śaṃtanu upon the Gaṅgā, both by the curse of Vasiṣṭha and by the command of Vāsava.

sanskrit: teṣām avarajo bhīṣmaḥ kurūṇām abhayaṃkaraḥ matimān vedavid vāgmī śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ
english: The youngest of them, Bhīṣma, the bestower of fearlessness upon the Kurus — wise, versed in the Veda, eloquent, and destroyer of the enemy host.

sanskrit: jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yaḥ sa sarvavidāṃ varaḥ ayudhyata mahātejā bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā
english: He who was the foremost among all knowers of wisdom, that greatly radiant one, fought with Rāma son of Jamadagni, the great-souled Bhārgava.

sanskrit: yas tu rājan kṛpo nāma brahmarṣir abhavat kṣitau rudrāṇāṃ taṃ gaṇād viddhi saṃbhūtam atipauruṣam
english: He who became the brahmarṣi known as Kṛpa upon the earth, O king — know him to have arisen from the host of the Rudras, of surpassing manhood.

sanskrit: śakunir nāma yas tv āsīd rājā loke mahārathaḥ dvāparaṃ viddhi taṃ rājan saṃbhūtam arimardanam
english: He who was the great warrior King Śakuni in the world — know him, O king, to have arisen as the Dvāpara age incarnate, the crusher of foes.

sanskrit: sātyakiḥ satyasaṃdhas tu yo 'sau vṛṣṇikulodvahaḥ pakṣāt sa jajñe marutāṃ devānām arimardanaḥ
english: Sātyaki, true to his word, the exalter of the Vṛṣṇi clan — that crusher of foes was born from a portion of the Marut gods.

sanskrit: drupadaś cāpi rājarṣis tata evābhavad gaṇāt mānuṣe nṛpa loke 'smin sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
english: Drupada too, the royal sage, arose from that same host and was born in this human world, O king, the foremost of all who bear weapons.

sanskrit: tataś ca kṛtavarmāṇaṃ viddhi rājañ janādhipam jātam apratikarmāṇaṃ kṣatriyarṣabhasattamam
english: And know Kṛtavarmā, O king, that lord of people, to have been born as one beyond recompense, the very finest bull among kṣatriya sages.

sanskrit: marutāṃ tu gaṇād viddhi saṃjātam arimardanam virāṭaṃ nāma rājarṣiṃ pararāṣṭrapratāpanam
english: Know the royal sage named Virāṭa, who terrorized the kingdoms of his rivals, to have been born from the host of the Maruts, a crusher of foes.

sanskrit: ariṣṭāyās tu yaḥ putro haṃsa ity abhiviśrutaḥ sa gandharvapatir jajñe kuruvaṃśavivardhanaḥ
english: The son of Ariṣṭā widely known as Haṃsa — that chief of Gandharvas was born as an enhancer of the Kuru lineage.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra iti khyātaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanād api dīrghabāhur mahātejāḥ prajñācakṣur narādhipaḥ mātur doṣād ṛṣeḥ kopād andha eva vyajāyata
english: Known as Dhṛtarāṣṭra, born also through Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana, the long-armed, greatly radiant lord of men who sees through wisdom — yet by reason of his mother's fault and the sage's wrath, he was born blind.

sanskrit: atres tu sumahābhāgaṃ putraṃ putravatāṃ varam viduraṃ viddhi loke 'smiñ jātaṃ buddhimatāṃ varam
english: Know Vidura, born in this world as the most blessed and finest son among those who have sons, to be an incarnation of Atri, the foremost among the wise.

sanskrit: kaler aṃśāt tu saṃjajñe bhuvi duryodhano nṛpaḥ durbuddhir durmatiś caiva kurūṇām ayaśaskaraḥ
english: From a portion of Kali was born on earth King Duryodhana — of wicked mind, wicked intellect, the one who brought disgrace upon the Kurus.

sanskrit: jagato yaḥ sa sarvasya vidviṣṭaḥ kalipūruṣaḥ yaḥ sarvāṃ ghātayām āsa pṛthivīṃ puruṣādhamaḥ yena vairaṃ samuddīptaṃ bhūtāntakaraṇaṃ mahat
english: He who was that embodiment of Kali, hated by the whole world, that lowest of men who caused the slaughter of all the earth — through whom the great enmity was kindled that brought destruction to all living beings.

sanskrit: paulastyā bhrātaraḥ sarve jajñire manujeṣv iha śataṃ duḥśāsanādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ krūrakarmaṇām
english: All the brothers, sons of Pulastya's lineage, were born among men here — the hundred headed by Duḥśāsana, all of cruel deeds.

sanskrit: durmukho duḥsahaś caiva ye cānye nānuśabditāḥ duryodhanasahāyās te paulastyā bharatarṣabha
english: Durmukha, Duḥsaha, and the others who are not individually named — all those helpers of Duryodhana are sons of Pulastya's line, O bull among the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: dharmasyāṃśaṃ tu rājānaṃ viddhi rājan yudhiṣṭhiram bhīmasenaṃ tu vātasya devarājasya cārjunam
english: Know King Yudhiṣṭhira to be a portion of Dharma, O king; Bhīmasena a portion of the Wind god; and Arjuna a portion of the king of gods.

sanskrit: aśvinos tu tathaivāṃśau rūpeṇāpratimau bhuvi nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca sarvalokamanoharau
english: Likewise Nakula and Sahadeva are portions of the twin Aśvins, peerless in beauty upon earth, captivating the hearts of all the worlds.

sanskrit: yaḥ suvarcā iti khyātaḥ somaputraḥ pratāpavān abhimanyur bṛhatkīrtir arjunasya suto 'bhavat
english: He who was known as Suvarcā, the mighty son of the Moon god — that Abhimanyu of great fame became the son of Arjuna.

sanskrit: agner aṃśaṃ tu viddhi tvaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham śikhaṇḍinam atho rājan strīpuṃsaṃ viddhi rākṣasam
english: Know Dhṛṣṭadyumna, that great warrior, to be a portion of Fire; and know Śikhaṇḍin, O king, who was both woman and man, to be a Rākṣasa.

sanskrit: draupadeyāś ca ye pañca babhūvur bharatarṣabha viśvedevagaṇān rājaṃs tān viddhi bharatarṣabha
english: The five sons of Draupadī who were born, O bull among the Bhāratas — know them, O king, to be members of the Viśvedeva host, O bull among the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: āmuktakavacaḥ karṇo yas tu jajñe mahārathaḥ divākarasya taṃ viddhi devasyāṃśam anuttamam
english: Karṇa, that great warrior who was born with armor already upon him — know him to be the incomparable portion of the Sun god, the resplendent deity.

sanskrit: yas tu nārāyaṇo nāma devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ tasyāṃśo mānuṣeṣv āsīd vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān
english: He who is known as Nārāyaṇa, the eternal god of gods — his portion among humans was the mighty Vāsudeva.

sanskrit: śeṣasyāṃśas tu nāgasya baladevo mahābalaḥ sanatkumāraṃ pradyumnaṃ viddhi rājan mahaujasam
english: Baladeva of great strength was a portion of the serpent Śeṣa; know Pradyumna, O king, to be the mighty Sanatkumāra.

sanskrit: evam anye manuṣyendra bahavo 'ṃśā divaukasām jajñire vasudevasya kule kulavivardhanāḥ
english: Thus many other portions of the celestials were born as enhancers of Vāsudeva's clan, O lord of men.

sanskrit: gaṇas tv apsarasāṃ yo vai mayā rājan prakīrtitaḥ tasya bhāgaḥ kṣitau jajñe niyogād vāsavasya ca
english: The host of Apsarases which I have enumerated for you, O king — a portion of them was born on earth also by the command of Vāsava.

sanskrit: tāni ṣoḍaśa devīnāṃ sahasrāṇi narādhipa babhūvur mānuṣe loke nārāyaṇaparigrahaḥ
english: Those sixteen thousand divine women, O lord of men, became in the human world the consorts of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit: śriyas tu bhāgaḥ saṃjajñe ratyarthaṃ pṛthivītale drupadasya kule kanyā vedimadhyād aninditā
english: A portion of Śrī was born for the purpose of desire upon the surface of the earth — a blameless maiden arising from the midst of the sacrificial altar in the family of Drupada.

sanskrit: nātihrasvā na mahatī nīlotpalasugandhinī padmāyatākṣī suśroṇī asitāyatamūrdhajā
english: Neither too short nor too tall, fragrant as the blue lotus, with long lotus-shaped eyes, lovely hips, and long dark hair —

sanskrit: sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā vaiḍūryamaṇisaṃnibhā pañcānāṃ puruṣendrāṇāṃ cittapramathinī rahaḥ
english: Endowed with all auspicious marks, resembling a vaiḍūrya gem, she was in private the one who bewildered the minds of five lords among men.

sanskrit: siddhir dhṛtiś ca ye devyau pañcānāṃ mātarau tu te kuntī mādrī ca jajñāte matis tu subalātmajā
english: The two goddesses Siddhi and Dhṛti were born as the mothers of the five — Kuntī and Mādrī; and Mati was born as the daughter of Subala.

sanskrit: iti devāsurāṇāṃ te gandharvāpsarasāṃ tathā aṃśāvataraṇaṃ rājan rākṣasānāṃ ca kīrtitam
english: Thus has been recounted for you, O king, the descent of portions of gods and demons, of Gandharvas and Apsarases, and of Rākṣasas.

sanskrit: ye pṛthivyāṃ samudbhūtā rājāno yuddhadurmadāḥ mahātmāno yadūnāṃ ca ye jātā vipule kule
english: The kings born on earth, intoxicated with battle, and the great-souled ones born in the vast clan of the Yadus —

sanskrit: dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ putrīyam āyuṣyaṃ vijayāvaham idam aṃśāvataraṇaṃ śrotavyam anasūyatā
english: This account of the descent of portions is auspicious, fame-giving, conducive to offspring, life-extending, and victory-bringing — it should be heard without envy.

sanskrit: aṃśāvataraṇaṃ śrutvā devagandharvarakṣasām prabhavāpyayavit prājño na kṛcchreṣv avasīdati
english: A wise man who hears this account of the descent of portions of gods, Gandharvas, and Rākṣasas, knowing their origin and dissolution, does not sink in times of distress.

sanskrit: janamejaya uvāca tvattaḥ śrutam idaṃ brahman devadānavarakṣasām aṃśāvataraṇaṃ samyag gandharvāpsarasāṃ tathā
english: Janamejaya said: I have heard from you, O brahmin, the full account of the descent of portions of gods, demons, and Rākṣasas, and likewise of Gandharvas and Apsarases.

sanskrit: imaṃ tu bhūya icchāmi kurūṇāṃ vaṃśam āditaḥ kathyamānaṃ tvayā vipra viprarṣigaṇasaṃnidhau
english: But I wish to hear further from you, O learned one, the lineage of the Kurus from the very beginning, narrated in the presence of this assembly of brahmin sages.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca pauravāṇāṃ vaṃśakaro duḥṣanto nāma vīryavān pṛthivyāś caturantāyā goptā bharatasattama
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: The perpetuator of the Paurava lineage was the valorous king named Duḥṣanta, the protector of the four-cornered earth, O foremost of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: caturbhāgaṃ bhuvaḥ kṛtsnaṃ sa bhuṅkte manujeśvaraḥ samudrāvaraṇāṃś cāpi deśān sa samitiṃjayaḥ
english: That lord of men enjoyed a full quarter of the entire earth, and that conqueror in battle also held the ocean-girdled lands.

sanskrit: āmlecchāṭavikān sarvān sa bhuṅkte ripumardanaḥ ratnākarasamudrāntāṃś cāturvarṇyajanāvṛtān
english: That crusher of foes enjoyed all the lands of the border peoples and forest dwellers, the lands extending to the jewel-bearing sea, inhabited by peoples of the four classes.

sanskrit: na varṇasaṃkarakaro nākṛṣyakarakṛjjanaḥ na pāpakṛt kaś cid āsīt tasmin rājani śāsati
english: There was no one who caused the mixing of castes, no one who refused to till the land, no evildoer whatsoever while that king was ruling.

sanskrit: dharmyāṃ ratiṃ sevamānā dharmārthāv abhipedire tadā narā naravyāghra tasmiñ janapadeśvare
english: Pursuing lawful pleasures, men then attained both righteousness and wealth, O tiger among men, under that lord of the realm.

sanskrit: nāsīc corabhayaṃ tāta na kṣudhābhayam aṇv api nāsīd vyādhibhayaṃ cāpi tasmiñ janapadeśvare
english: There was no fear of thieves, dear one, not the slightest fear of hunger, and no fear of disease either under that lord of the realm.

sanskrit: svair dharmai remire varṇā daive karmaṇi niḥspṛhāḥ tam āśritya mahīpālam āsaṃś caivākutobhayāḥ
english: The castes delighted in their own duties, desireless in their divine observances; having taken refuge in that guardian of the earth, they were free from fear from any quarter.

sanskrit: kālavarṣī ca parjanyaḥ sasyāni phalavanti ca sarvaratnasamṛddhā ca mahī vasumatī tadā
english: Rain fell in its proper season, crops bore fruit abundantly, and the earth, the treasure-bearer, was rich with all gems at that time.

sanskrit: sa cādbhutamahāvīryo vajrasaṃhanano yuvā udyamya mandaraṃ dorbhyāṃ haret savanakānanam
english: And he, of marvelous great valor, youthful and firm as the thunderbolt, could lift Mount Mandara with his two arms and carry it along with its forest of soma-pressing trees.

sanskrit: dhanuṣy atha gadāyuddhe tsarupraharaṇeṣu ca nāgapṛṣṭhe 'śvapṛṣṭhe ca babhūva pariniṣṭhitaḥ
english: In archery, in mace combat, in fighting with sword and hilt, on elephant-back, and on horseback, he was fully accomplished.

sanskrit: bale viṣṇusamaś cāsīt tejasā bhāskaropamaḥ akṣubdhatve 'rṇavasamaḥ sahiṣṇutve dharāsamaḥ
english: In strength he was equal to Viṣṇu, in splendor like the sun, in imperturbability like the ocean, in forbearance like the earth.

sanskrit: saṃmataḥ sa mahīpālaḥ prasannapurarāṣṭravān bhūyo dharmaparair bhāvair viditaṃ janam āvasat
english: That guardian of the earth, honored by all, his city and kingdom contented, dwelt among the people he knew well, with dispositions ever devoted to righteousness.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca sa kadā cin mahābāhuḥ prabhūtabalavāhanaḥ vanaṃ jagāma gahanaṃ hayanāgaśatair vṛtaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Once that long-armed one, possessed of abundant troops and vehicles, went into a dense forest, surrounded by hundreds of horses and elephants.
